picks.title: Legacy of the Battletown Witch | Encore Episode
picks.summary:
For nearly two centuries, folks in Battletown, Kentucky, have passed down the story of Leah Smock, a young woman who legend claims was accused of witchcraft and burned alive by her neighbors in 1840. Stories say Leah could predict the future, communicate with wild animals, and even place curses on those who crossed her. After her death, some claimed her spirit remained in the woods surrounding her lonely grave, earning her a place in local folklore as the Battletown Witch.

But behind the stories of witchcraft and hauntings was a real young woman whose life ended under mysterious and violent c
picks.reason: Folklore about a witch's legacy exploring belief, fear, and community memory.

picks.title: Egyptian Gods Explained 🐍☀️ | The Gods, Myths, and Legends of Ancient Egypt | Boring History for Sleep
picks.summary: The gods of ancient Egypt were woven into almost every part of life, from the rising sun and the flooding Nile to kingship, protection, death, and the journey into the afterlife. But who were these powerful and mysterious deities?This documentary explores the fascinating world of Egyptian mythology, from Ra, Osiris, Isis, and Horus to Anubis, Set, Thoth, and many lesser-known gods and goddesses. Discover their stories, symbols, relationships, rivalries, and the myths that shaped how ancient Egyptians understood the world around them.Why were Egyptian gods often portrayed with animal features?
picks.reason: Detailed exploration of Egyptian gods and myths addressing death and afterlife beliefs.
